rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides secure SSH connectivity and remote server management capabilities through comprehensive session management. Enables command execution, file transfers via SFTP, and interactive shell sessions with support for multiple concurrent SSH connections. Features configurable authentication methods including password, private key, and SSH agent support. Includes predefined host configurations for quick connections, automatic session cleanup, async mode with circular buffer for long-running operations, and proper PTY handling for interactive programs like vim, htop, and debuggers.
